description: Pairs no longer traded (Android NotTraded.kt / iOS NotTraded.swift): stored lastError -> isMarker and the 24 h change that is shown (null = dash). Only the exact marker text counts. askSingleWhenMissing: pair missing from a complete bulk list -> ask it once by single ticker (not again once marked). confirmedBySingle: single result -> mark not traded only on a clear statement about the pair: answer without a price (no data, no error text), an explicit unknown-instrument text (does not exist, unknown asset pair, invalid symbol ...) or HTTP 400/404; any other error (unreadable answer, unknown exception, network, timeout, rate limit, other 4xx, 5xx, missing adapter) stays an ordinary error.
